changeSet.sql: IF EXISTS (SELECT * FROM INFORMATION_SCHEMA.TABLES WHERE TABLE_SCHEMA = 'dbo' AND TABLE_NAME = 'Lookup_backup') BEGIN DROP TABLE dbo.Lookup_backup END
changeSet.rollback:
IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT * FROM INFORMATION_SCHEMA.TABLES WHERE TABLE_SCHEMA = 'dbo' AND TABLE_NAME = 'Lookup_backup') BEGIN CREATE TABLE [dbo].[Lookup_backup]( [ID] [int] IDENTITY(1,1) NOT NULL, [LookupTypeID] [int] NOT NULL, [UpdatedOn] [datetime] NULL, [UpdatedBy] [int] NULL, CONSTRAINT [PK_Lookup] PRIMARY KEY CLUSTERED ( [ID] ASC ) ) END
IF NOT EXISTS (select * from sys.indexes where name = 'IX_Lookup_LookupTypeID') BEGIN CREATE NONCLUSTERED INDEX [IX_Lookup_LookupTypeID] ON [dbo].[Lookup_backup] ( [LookupTypeID] ASC ) END

CREATE OR ALTER TRIGGER [dbo].[Lookup_AfterDelete] ON [dbo].[Lookup_backup] AFTER DELETE AS BEGIN SET NOCOUNT ON
INSERT INTO [queue].[Task] ([Action], [Custom], [Object], [ObjectID]) select 'Delete', [queue].WriteIndexXml('Removed', 'LookupType', LookupTypeID, coalesce(UpdatedBy, 0)), 'Lookup', ID from deleted END
